sent.csv.description: written by the sender, one row per probe sent

columns.name: seq
columns.description: probe sequence number, starts at 0, +1 per probe

columns.name: scheduled_mono_ns
columns.description: sender CLOCK_MONOTONIC instant the probe was due (t0 + seq*interval)

columns.name: send_mono_ns
columns.description: sender CLOCK_MONOTONIC when the probe was built, just before sendto()

columns.name: send_wall_ns
columns.description: sender wall clock (CLOCK_REALTIME) at the same moment; correlation only

columns.name: size_bytes
columns.description: UDP payload length

columns.name: send_errno
columns.description: 0 if sendto succeeded, else errno (not counted as network loss)

echoes.csv.description: written by the sender, one row per echo received

columns.name: seq
columns.description: probe sequence number, starts at 0, +1 per probe

columns.name: recv_mono_ns
columns.description: this process's CLOCK_MONOTONIC right after recvfrom() returned

columns.name: recv_wall_ns
columns.description: wall clock at the same moment; correlation only

columns.name: size_bytes
columns.description: UDP payload length

received.csv.description: written by the receiver, one row per valid probe received (duplicates kept)

columns.name: seq
columns.description: probe sequence number, starts at 0, +1 per probe

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: random id chosen by the sender per run

columns.name: recv_mono_ns
columns.description: this process's CLOCK_MONOTONIC right after recvfrom() returned

columns.name: recv_wall_ns
columns.description: wall clock at the same moment; correlation only

columns.name: hdr_send_mono_ns
columns.description: sender monotonic stamp copied from the packet header (cross-process use only on one host)

columns.name: hdr_send_wall_ns
columns.description: sender wall stamp from the packet header

columns.name: size_bytes
columns.description: UDP payload length

columns.name: src_addr
columns.description: source IPv4 seen by the receiver

columns.name: src_port
columns.description: source UDP port

events.csv.description: written by the orchestrator / impairment proxy

columns.name: event_id
columns.description: pairs handoff_start/handoff_end (e.g. handoff-1)

columns.name: kind
columns.description: scenario_start | scenario_end | handoff_start | handoff_end | note

columns.name: mono_ns
columns.description: orchestrator CLOCK_MONOTONIC (same-host comparable with packet stamps)

columns.name: wall_ns
columns.description: orchestrator wall clock

columns.name: detail
columns.description: free text
